GFX Digitization System

Our state-of-the-art FUJIFILM GFX Digitization System offers cutting-edge technology for the fastest, highest-quality film and print digitization. The system can digitize any format from Super 8mm to 8 x 10.

*Penumbra facilities are available to be rented by MEMBERS ONLY.

Not a member? Become one today!

WHAT’S INCLUDED?

  • FUJIFILM GFX 100SII Medium Format Mirrorless Camera

  • Kaiser RS10 Copy Stand with RTP Arm

  • Apple Mac Studio M2 Max and Capture One Pro

  • Calibrated EIZO ColorEdge CS2740 26.9" 4K Monitor

  • Neewer NL-288A RC LED Panel

  • Film Holders

    • toneCarrier 35mm and 120 Scanning Kits (ideal for uncut rolls)

    • Beseler Enlarger Carriers: Super 8, 16mm, 35mm, 120 (645, 6x6, 6x7, 6x9), and 4x5

    • Contact sheet holder for 8x10 negatives

      *please contact us beforehand if you need the 8x10 holder

  • Enlarging Lenses (Novoflex Mount & Bellows)

    • Fujinon-ES 135mm f4.5

    • Schneider Kreuznach Pyrite V38 90mm f4.5

    • Schneider Kreuznach Apo-Componon 60mm f4 Makro-Iris

*Novoflex Adapter available for Sony E-Mount system

RESERVE YOUR SPOT!

Rentals are available in 2-hour blocks (see below). For longer rentals, choose a 2-hour slot and use "select and add another time." For hourly rentals, email info@penumbrafoundation.org.
Our Digitization System was made possible by a 2024 Capital Grant by New York State Council on the Arts with the support of the Office of the Governor and the New York State Legislature.
We’d like to thank tonePhotographic for sponsoring our new film carrier system.
If you have any questions about renting our facilities, please reach out to info@penumbrafoundation.org
